# Vendored mcp-usage-control packages

These tarballs are intentionally vendored because the packages are not published to npm yet.
They were packed from local checkout `git-ksk/mcp-usage-control` at commit `bf4a6df` and package version `0.7.0` using the repository-pinned pnpm 10.15.0.

Included:
- `mcp-usage-control` — core transactional reservation / liability / settlement contract
- `mcp-usage-control-firestore` — server-side Firestore transactional UsageStore

Repack from the upstream checkout and rerun the full consumer test suite before updating these files.
